title: Xie et al., Tabby: An Open Pretraining Recipe for Time Series Foundation Models (abstract page)
note: Fetched abstract page. v1 submitted 12 Sep 2026, v2 29 Sep 2026, cs.LG, 43-page technical report from Huawei Noah's Ark Lab. Releases a 145M-parameter encoder-only patch transformer with contexts up to 8,192 points and the recipe used to train it; says zero-shot accuracy is competitive on GIFT-Eval and on TIME. Paper text licence CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Code at huawei-noah/trustworthyAI.

title: Xie et al., Tabby, full text v2: forecasting results
note: Section 8.1 read. GIFT-Eval is called in-distribution (pretraining pool derived from its pretraining set, prompt tuned on its training split); TIME (98 tasks) is the out-of-distribution test. Text says Tabby beats Sundial, TimesFM 2.5 and Chronos-Bolt on GIFT-Eval, and those plus Moirai-2.0 on TIME, by MASE and CRPS. The scores are in Figure 2 only, an image; no numbers in the text read.

title: Xie et al., Tabby, full text v2: task formulation and limits
note: Sections 3, 10 and appendix A.5 read by keyword, not the whole 43 pages. The task is univariate: history in, quantiles out. The authors' first stated limitation is that the model is channel-independent and does not model other variables or external covariates. Ablations use a 40M Tabby-Small. No electric load, week-ahead or weather experiment was found by keyword search.

title: Xie et al., Tabby, full text v2: pretraining data
note: Section 5 and appendix B inventory. Real data: GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+ (extended with sets from the Chronos and TiRex-2 corpora after quality and benchmark-separation filters) and BLAST; synthetic: KernelSynth and CauKerV2. The inventory lists hourly load sets (gfc12_load, gfc14_load, gfc17_load, elf, smart) and Australian demand. No PJM or EIA name found by keyword; BLAST contents are not itemised.

title: paris-noah/Tabby (model card)
note: Card of the full model: frozen Tabby-Pretrain backbone (step 165,000) plus a 160-token prompt trained on 48 GIFT-Eval training tasks, 146.7M parameters, 99 quantiles. GIFT-Eval, 97 configurations, seasonal-naive-normalised: prompted 0.6880 MASE and 0.4758 CRPS; backbone alone 0.7040 and 0.4827. Says its leaderboard entry is marked as having test-data leakage. Licence CC BY-NC 4.0.

title: paris-noah/Tabby (model card): inference rule
note: Inference: for horizon H the model masks max(H, 128) future positions inside an 8,192 window, so a 168-step forecast can use at most 8,024 history points. Each variate is forecast on its own; missing history values are accepted. Loads through transformers AutoModel with remote code. No TIME aggregate is claimed: 98 task outputs are supplied for official scoring.

title: paris-noah/Tabby (Hub API record)
note: Hub record: created 2026-09-10, head 6c60343 (2026-11-06), licence cc-by-nc-4.0, not gated, pipeline time-series-forecasting, custom code, 146,695,591 float32 parameters in model.safetensors, 15,843 downloads last month.

title: huawei-noah/trustworthyAI, TabbyTSFM directory
note: Authors' code: pretraining and prompt-training recipes, a GluonTS-style predictor, and evaluation scripts for GIFT-Eval, TIME, UCR and TSB-AD. Added 11 Sep 2026; last change 19 Sep 2026 (a fix to the GIFT-Eval history-length setting). Examples run on a GPU in bf16; memory is about 21 MiB per series at the full window plus 0.6 GB of weights. No checkpoints or data are bundled.

title: paris-noah/Tabby-Pretrain (model card)
note: Card of the frozen backbone, the zero-shot model: 145.84M parameters, 20 layers, 16-step patches, 8,192 window, 99 quantiles. GIFT-Eval zero-shot reference over 97 configurations at 8,096 context and the 128-step minimum span: MASE 0.7040, CRPS 0.4827. No TIME aggregate claimed. Training mix: BLAST 0.3, GIFT-Eval pretraining pool 0.3, KernelSynth 0.3, CauKer-V2 0.1. Licence CC BY-NC 4.0.

title: TimeCopilot/foundationforecast pull request 76: add Tabby wrapper
note: Opened 22 Oct 2026 by a library maintainer, merged (cb63ddc). Adds a Tabby wrapper that loads paris-noah/Tabby: 99 quantiles, no exogenous inputs. Its GIFT-Eval harness reproduces the official prompted entry (MASE 0.688, CRPS 0.4758) at 8,096 context with bf16. Notes that both public Tabby leaderboard submissions are flagged for test-data leakage.

title: Timestral, t0, Tabby, and Morpheus-2.0 Compared on GIFT-Eval (Towards Data Science)
note: Independent rerun with the authors' script on a rented GPU. Tabby-Pretrain reproduces the official 0.4827 CRPS and 0.7040 MASE only with the model card's 128-step minimum span; the script default gave 0.4923 and 0.7192, with 15 tasks more than 5% worse. Date not on the page as fetched; the text refers to 30 Oct 2026. Code: sjmoran/tsfm-gifteval-rerun (not fetched).

title: Timestral, t0, Tabby, and Morpheus-2.0 Compared on GIFT-Eval: Tabby's inputs and leak flag
note: Same article. Tabby reads the target history only and cannot use a temperature forecast. The leaderboard Tabby entry is prompt-tuned and sits among fine-tuned models; zero-shot Tabby-Pretrain is just ahead of Chronos-2 on CRPS. A 29 Oct 2026 commit by the lead author changes both entries' leak flag to No while the model card still says Yes. Weights are non-commercial.
